text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having reached the end of her Tiara tour, Air Groove has earned significant renown as the Empress, and the public watches her with fervor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she's not alone in the limelight.

text_block_list.name: TV Caster
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka is in the lead! Silence Suzuka is in the lead!

text_block_list.name: TV Caster
text_block_list.text: And she crosses the finishing line in first! Nobody can take that lead from her! She's incredible!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The other racer making waves is an Umamusume known as the Otherworldly Front-Runner—Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When considering Air Groove's future challenges, Silence Suzuka is someone who can't be ignored.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove's senior year is almost upon us. I need to talk to her about our plans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The student council is holding a large-scale scrimmage event today to help everyone improve their skills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Naturally, Air Groove is helping organize, so I decide to lend a hand as well.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Look, look! Isn't that Silence Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Yeah, it is! I didn't know she was running in the scrimmages today!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: We're so lucky! How many chances do you get to go all out with Silence Suzuka?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Spectators and participants alike are excited by Silence Suzuka's presence.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Is that… Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove is also looking at Silence Suzuka, a look of astonishment visible upon her face.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You may not be aware of this, but Suzuka and I are already acquainted with one another.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We've practiced together a number of times. I thought I was well aware of her potential.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: However…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Something's happened to her. She's nothing like she was before.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: In simple terms… She has a completely different air about her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Since beginning our Twinkle Series careers, we may have run into each other now and then at the academy, but we haven't actually met on the track.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I've seen footage of her running, of course, but I had no idea she had come this far…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As a highly talented Umamusume herself, Air Groove must be able to sense something in Silence Suzuka that I can't.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She keeps her gaze fixed on Suzuka for a few excruciating seconds, until…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I need to find out for myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She dashes off without warning, and I chase after her in a fluster.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Things seem to be progressing without issue. The next group is—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Groove? Is there an issue in the stands?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No, there's no issue. I have a personal request.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And what might that be?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I am fully aware that this is out of line, but I want to ask if I can race against Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It's rare for you to ask something of me. I would happily oblige, but the allocations for Silence Suzuka's group are already—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I would like to make the same request.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You wish to race against Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I do. I'm also curious to see how she has changed since we last ran together.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Air Groove is gonna race against Silence Suzuka?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Omigosh, no way! We've gotta see this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume nearby perk up at the potential matchup and word begins to spread.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: My goodness. I can't exactly say no now, can I? You have my consent. I'll sort out the arrangements.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for your magnanimity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: True to her word, Rudolf quickly organizes a scrimmage between Air Groove and Silence Suzuka, and soon enough…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka races ahead and takes the lead, with Air Groove giving chase. So far, the scene on the track is playing out just as everyone expects.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (Ngh… What incredible speed! She's always been a front runner, but this is on an entirely different level!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (But I haven't let her slip out of my range yet… I will snatch that lead from her!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the race reaches the final turn, Air Groove attempts to surge forward, but…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hahhh!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (What the—?!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka picks up her pace. Try as she might to close in, Air Groove finds herself only falling even farther behind.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (There's no way…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove finishes the race without even managing to catch Silence Suzuka's shadow.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Spectator A
text_block_list.text: D-did you see that?! She was in front the whole time, but somehow she still zoomed ahead at the end! Talk about wild!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Spectator B
text_block_list.text: She managed to stay ahead of Air Groove! That's… unbelievable.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Good race, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah… Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You were magnificent, Suzuka. I'm glad I was able to race you today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Me too. I look forward to facing you in a proper match.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes… As do I.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Well then, until we meet again.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night in my office, I think back on Air Groove and Silence Suzuka's race.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I thought you might be here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I have something to discuss with you. Or rather, I have a request.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I want you to enter me in a race where I'm likely to go up against Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You saw what happened today. She completely outclassed me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: In the challenges that lie ahead, Suzuka presents an obstacle that I will need to overcome.
choice_data_list: Then let's aim for the Osaka Hai.
Then let's aim for the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Of all our options in the near future, this is the race where Silence Suzuka is most likely to show. If we want to face her, it has to be our best bet.
choice_data_list: Let's take down Silence Suzuka together.
Let's take down Silence Suzuka together.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Thank you for indulging my selfish request. I promise you, this time I won't lose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we make beating Silence Suzuka our next goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next race is the Osaka Hai! We can't leave things as they stand now!
